build_transforms_for_training: build a torchvision transform pipeline for training with random resized crop and horizontal flip
build_transforms_for_validation: build a torchvision transform pipeline for validation with center crop and normalization
create_resize_with_largest: create a custom Resize transform that resizes to a common largest side without cropping
refactor_get_transforms_backbone: refactor get_transforms to use different normalization mean and std for pnasnet5large or nasnetamobile backbones
test_resize_target_size: test the Resize.target_size static method to compute correct target dimensions for given width height and size
